items.basis: Cavitation cannot occur under the stated conditions: to nucleate and grow a bubble against 14 bar static pressure, the Blake threshold requires rarefaction pressure of roughly P0 + 0.77σ/R ≈ 14 bar + ~1 bar ≈ 15 bar tensile at the liquid; a 600 W transducer of ~50 mm face (~0.002 m²) delivers intensity ~3×10^5 W/m², i.e. acoustic pressure amplitude p = √(2ρcI) ≈ √(2×1.5×10^6×3×10^5) ≈ 9.5 bar at its own face, and coupling from the steel header wall (Z_steel ≈ 47 MRayl) into water (Z_water ≈ 1.5 MRayl) transmits only ~4Z1Z2/(Z1+Z2)² ≈ 12% of the power, cutting amplitude to ~3.3 bar in the water
